title: The Opening
text:
The Opening.
The wind carried the smell of rain across the valley. Urza Planeswalker watched the horizon in silence. Mishra's brother did not answer, and “nobody spoke,” he said. Rhûn was far, and Éowyn was farther. Terenas Menethil II ruled, but Henry VIII did not; see Part II and Chapter IV. St. Anselm lit a lamp 🙂 at dusk!
